## Hy4 API

Hy4 is a large language model by Tencent Hunyuan, available on the Venice API as `hy4`. This model is private and no prompt data is stored in any capacity.

Hy4 is a 770B-parameter Mixture-of-Experts flagship model from the Tencent Hy team, with 49B parameters active per token and a 1M-token context window. It is post-trained for software engineering, office and data analysis, game development, and scientific research, with strong long-horizon reasoning, tool use, and agentic performance.

### Hy4 API pricing

| Model ID | Variant | Privacy | Price |
|---|---|---|---|
| `hy4` | Standard | Private | $1.04 / $3.13 per 1M |

### Hy4 specifications

| Spec | Value |
|---|---|
| Provider | Tencent Hunyuan |
| Released | Nov 25, 2026 |
| Privacy | Private |
| Status | Stable |
| Open weights | [tencent/Hy4](https://huggingface.co/tencent/Hy4) |
| Context window | 1M tokens |
| Max output | 64K tokens |
| Reasoning effort | none, low, high |
| Served precision | FP4 |
| [Live speed and uptime](/models/methodology#machine-readable-data) | https://metrics.venice.ai/v1/models/hy4.json, refreshed every 5 minutes |

### How to use the Hy4 API

Send requests to `POST https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/chat/completions` with `"model": "hy4"` and your API key.

```bash
curl https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/chat/completions \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $VENICE_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "model": "hy4",
    "messages": [{ "role": "user", "content": "Explain TEE attestation in two sentences." }],
    "reasoning_effort": "high"
  }'
```
